question: Which industry in India is its own largest consumer?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Chemical industry. **__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The chemical industry is its** own biggest consumer.**
 
• Basic chemicals undergo processing to further make other chemicals that are used for **industrial implementation, agriculture or directly for consumer markets. **
 
• Chemical Industries are one of their own biggest consumers as the finished product of a Chemical industry is mostly used as a **raw material for the other Chemical industries.**
 
• The chemical industry is its own largest consumer as basic chemicals undergo processing to further produce other** chemicals that are used for numerous things.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cement and petrochemicals** are manufactured by large-scale industries.
 
• **The automobile industry** is all those companies and activities involved in the manufacture of motor vehicles, including most components, like **engines and bodies, but excluding tires, batteries, and fuel.​ **
 
• **The steel industry** is the business of purifying** iron ore into steel.**
